catalogue_of_life.notes: Pinned release metadata only. Taxon matches remain review-required until imported and approved.

gbif.role: name matching, occurrences, distribution evidence and media discovery
gbif.notes: Record the retrieval date, dataset and licence for every imported record.

wikimedia.role: supplemental readable summaries, multilingual labels and individually licensed media

open_tree_of_life.notes: Pin the Open Tree taxonomy and synthetic-tree versions when imported.

florabase.role: Western Australian taxon profiles, descriptive fields and regional status
florabase.notes: Curated profile snapshot retrieved 17 June 2026. Florabase warns that WAHerb and WACensus have been read-only since 1 October 2025 during migration testing, so later APC/Catalogue of Life cross-checking remains required.

australian_plant_census.role: National accepted-name and taxonomic-concept cross-check for Australian vascular plants
australian_plant_census.notes: Registered as a required authority but no APC records are claimed imported in v0.4.0.

plants_of_the_world_online.role: Accepted names, synonyms, authorship and native-range cross-check for vascular plants
plants_of_the_world_online.notes: Ten v0.11 records were checked against POWO/WCVP on 17 June 2026. Record-level identifiers and URLs are retained; Catalogue of Life review remains separate.
